title: Preserve startup evidence in H25 optimized-refusal handling
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Preserve the original startup evidence when the H25 optimized invocation reaches its intended assertion-enabled-entry refusal. The candidate runner previously required the output directory to be absent, although the original startup creates it before that refusal. The correction retains those artifacts and requires the original exit-1 traceback, no positive scientific output, complete capture and the existing terminal ownership checks.

The normal and optimized command profiles now match their separate full source selections. This is a scoped correctness repair and inert source handoff. Complete caller/environment qualification, actual scientific comparison and performance gains remain unclaimed.

## Task and overlap

Explicit user-assigned repair against canonical base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`; original scope is preserved. Follow-up to [#6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321) and [#6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029), using the unchanged caller/source contracts in [#6744](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6744), [#6736](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6736) and [#6715](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6715). Exact dependency heads and byte mappings are in the package README and SNAPSHOTS.json.

The [#6780](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6780) compatibility question remains open. This patch supplies the concrete original-refusal correction; it does not treat a related archive or passing CI as complete integration.

## Validation

Independent AI review accepted the actual refusal/profile connection. The authenticated pure predicate passed 22 fixed controls in normal mode and 22 under optimization, including the preserved startup case and meaningful wrong-result, incomplete-evidence and limit-boundary cases. Raw reports and exact subject pins are retained.

The complete runner, scientific program, compiler and native entry were not executed. Source snapshots are inert. Full scientific payloads and admission inputs remain explicitly external; complete cold replay availability is unverified. No generic complete-science replay hook is added.

See README.md for package-local integrity and pure-control commands, adapter verification and the exact evidence boundary.

## Credit

Preserves CrocSwap/H25 source, predecessor and parallel contributor attribution. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, GPT-6.1-sol agents and independent AI review; Apache-2.0. AI review does not constitute human or proof-kernel acceptance.

## Open next questions

Establish the finite native/profile compatibility consequences, independently accept the complete caller, then obtain genuine execution admission and perform the actual baseline/candidate comparison with complete costs. The smallest next check and blockers are recorded in the package README.
